title: 第二十五章 欠你一两第二十六章 守株待兔
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
如果说老美文化是披着文明躯壳的丛林社会，那么这个世界就是真正的狩猎场，没有实力只能像蝼蚁一样任由践踏了。
经过黄守业这件事，足以说明这边官方是没有任何动作的。
三天，够了。
林枫收拾一番，便前往义冢。
路过牛马市场的时候，林枫看到田家武馆的弟子明显变多了，到处在寻找田广文和田广元两人。
显然他们还没有任何的线索。
永关县城的猎户非常多，大部分都是黑户。
今天来明天不来的，流动性非常大。
就算知道那个猎户有问题，也找不到。
林枫没有张扬，低调的出了城。
前往义冢的路上，原本晴朗的天空，突然乌云密布，变得阴沉起来。
风骤然间变得狂躁起来。
林枫宽松的衣袍，此刻也紧贴在身。
狂风肆虐，林枫眼前已经形成了一片黄雾，防止黄土进入眼睛，林枫只能半眯起眼睛。
这天眼看就要下雨了，一时间林枫有些犹豫。
到底还要不要去义冢。
一想到黄守业的嚣张，林枫眼神就闪烁着杀意，变得凶狠起来。
就算暴雨来了躲在空间就是。
想到这，林枫加快了脚步。
抵达义冢后，时间还早并未看到赵二牛。

林枫并没有着急，时间还没到。
大概过了十分钟左右，乌云越来越浓郁，周围像是拉下黑色帷幕一样。
一道紫色闪电，划破虚空。
借着雷光，林枫隐约间看到一个人影向这边走来。
约莫一盏茶左右，林枫终于看清来人。
正是赵二牛。
只见赵二牛并未推着架子车，而是背着一头猎物缓缓走来。
走近一看，便看清了猎物，是两头野山羊。
虽是山羊，但体格却是十分的壮硕、。
见到林枫，赵二牛欣喜道：“林公子我以为你不会来了”
林枫：“嗯，本来不打算来的，怕你白跑一趟”
“嗨，白跑啥，你不在我就拿到城里卖，一样的”
“城里现在可是到处找你，你还是低调一些”
“没事，那些家伙都是三脚猫，根本不在意”
林枫感觉有被冒犯到了。
content_en:
If old American culture is a jungle society cloaked in the shell of civilization, then this world is a real hunting ground. Without strength, people can only be trampled like ants.
After Huang Shouye's incident, it is enough to show that the officials here have not taken any action.
Three days is enough.
Lin Feng tidied up and headed to the cemetery.
When passing by the cattle and horse market, Lin Feng saw that there were obviously more disciples in the Tianjia Martial Arts School, and they were looking for Tian Guangwen and Tian Guangyuan everywhere.
Apparently they don't have any clues yet.
There are many hunters in Yongguan County, most of them are black households.
Those who come today may not come tomorrow, and the liquidity is very high.
Even if we knew there was something wrong with that Orion, we still couldn't find it.
Lin Feng left the city without any fanfare and kept a low profile.
On the way to the cemetery, the originally clear sky suddenly became covered with dark clouds and became gloomy.
The wind suddenly became wild.
Lin Feng's loose robe also clung to him at this moment.
The strong wind was raging, and a yellow mist had formed in front of Lin Feng's eyes to prevent the loess from entering his eyes. Lin Feng could only half-squint his eyes.
It was going to rain that day, and Lin Feng hesitated for a while.
Should I still go to the cemetery?
When he thought of Huang Shouye's arrogance, Lin Feng's eyes flashed with murderous intent and became fierce.
Even if a heavy rain comes, just hide in the space.
Thinking of this, Lin Feng quickened his pace.
After arriving at the cemetery, it was still early and Zhao Erniu was not seen.
Lin Feng was not in a hurry, the time had not come yet.
After about ten minutes, the dark clouds became thicker and thicker, and it was like a black curtain had been drawn around.
A bolt of purple lightning pierced the void.
With the help of lightning, Lin Feng vaguely saw a figure walking towards this side.
After about a cup of tea, Lin Feng finally saw the person clearly.
It was Zhao Erniu.
I saw that Zhao Erniu was not pushing a cart, but was walking slowly with a prey on his back.
As I got closer, I saw clearly the prey, which were two wild goats.
Although it is a goat, its physique is very strong.
Seeing Lin Feng, Zhao Erniu said happily: "Master Lin, I thought you wouldn't come."
Lin Feng: "Well, I didn't plan to come. I was afraid that your trip would be in vain."
"Hey, why are you running for nothing? If you're not here, I'll sell them in the city. It's the same thing."
"People are looking for you everywhere in the city now, so you should keep a low profile."
"It's okay, those guys are all three-legged cats, they don't care at all"
Lin Feng felt offended.
